topic: The man who paid strangers to push shopping carts
canonical_en: Why did the inventor of the shopping cart pay people to push empty carts?
title: He Paid Strangers to Push Empty Carts
description: Nobody wanted the first shopping cart, so its inventor hired a crowd. Here's why it worked.
facts_checked: Sylvan Goldman introduced the shopping cart in 1937 at Humpty Dumpty stores, Oklahoma City, and hired people to push carts -> oklahomahistory.net

scenes.line: He paid strangers to push empty carts around his own store.
scenes.visual: Goldman in his grocery watching two hired strangers push empty carts down the aisle

scenes.line: In nineteen thirty-seven, Sylvan Goldman ran a small grocery in Oklahoma City.
scenes.visual: wide street shot of the corner grocery, Goldman proudly at the door

scenes.line: His shoppers only bought what fit in one small basket, then they went home.
scenes.visual: a tired shopper at the counter with one overflowing basket

scenes.line: So one night in his workshop, he bolted wheels and two baskets onto a folding chair.
scenes.visual: Goldman at the workbench at night, building the first cart

scenes.line: The next morning, he proudly lined up his shiny new carts by the front door.
scenes.visual: Goldman presenting the carts outside the store

scenes.line: Nobody touched them. Not one single shopper.
scenes.visual: shoppers walking past the carts without looking

scenes.line: Men said they looked silly, and women said they looked like baby strollers.
scenes.visual: a man and a woman shaking their heads at the carts

scenes.line: Even his own staff laughed at him. You're ruining the store!
So Goldman hired actors to push full carts up and down the aisles all day long.
scenes.visual: actors pushing full carts, Goldman watching with a smirk

scenes.line: One shopper copied them. Then another. Then the whole store.
scenes.visual: one, then two, then a crowd of shoppers with carts

scenes.line: You see, people trust a crowd much more than they trust a good idea.
scenes.visual: Goldman winking at the camera in front of the busy store

scenes.line: His carts rolled into every supermarket in America, and the joke made him a multimillionaire.
scenes.visual: Goldman outside the bank with a chest of gold
